claims: The Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team plays the Michigan Wolverines in the NCAA Final Four.
The game is on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The game is at approximately 5:49 p.m. PT.
The game's location is Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
The game is televised on TBS.
Live streaming of the game is available on NCAA.com.
Radio coverage of the game is on Wildcats Sports Radio 1290 AM.
Arizona advanced to the Final Four.
Tommy Lloyd is head coach of Arizona.
Tommy Lloyd recently signed a contract extension through the 2031 season.
